purpose: Create evidence-gated readiness analysis for digital solutions by comparing declared purpose, documentation, implementation, tests and observed behaviour. Deterministic controls govern findings and progression; named humans retain formal decision authority.

requirements.title: Safe evidence intake and provenance
requirements.requirement: Acquire supported source material as inert evidence. Record source IDs, hashes, locators, extraction methods and limitations before reasoning. Uploaded instructions must not change control logic.
requirements.acceptance: A file containing executable or instruction-like content is never executed. Every acquired unit has a source ID, hash and locator; unreadable units remain explicit limitations.
requirements.deliverable: Source ingestion manifest and local acquisition adapters
requirements.test: Submit mixed source files with embedded instructions and an unreadable unit; inspect the manifest and confirm that no content is executed.
requirements.evidence: Manifest fixture and acquisition boundary test record

requirements.title: Human confirmed intake
requirements.requirement: Present purpose, users, data, autonomy, lifecycle and uncertainty for human review. Only an explicit user action freezes the approved intake and permits assessment.
requirements.acceptance: Assessment cannot start before confirmation. The confirmed snapshot is hashed and bound to the acquisition manifest; unknown fields remain visible.
requirements.deliverable: Intake workspace and immutable confirmation snapshot
requirements.test: Attempt analysis before confirmation, confirm an intake containing unknowns, and check snapshot and manifest binding.
requirements.evidence: Confirmation gate and snapshot test record

requirements.title: Governed knowledge snapshot
requirements.requirement: Validate versioned sources, requirements, controls, anti-patterns and tactics as governed criteria. Methodology must never count as evidence about the assessed solution.
requirements.acceptance: An invalid manifest hash or unknown assessment object prevents activation. Criteria remain separate from case evidence throughout the package.
requirements.deliverable: Knowledge loader with manifest and reference validation
requirements.test: Load valid and invalid knowledge manifests; submit a claim using an unknown object ID and inspect rejection.
requirements.evidence: Knowledge integrity and reference test record

requirements.title: Complete A to F coverage
requirements.requirement: Apply the six governance domains using 30 capabilities, 30 paired anti-patterns and three primary questions per object. Record explicit results and applicability for all 180 work items.
requirements.acceptance: The coverage matrix accounts for all 180 work items. Missing evidence produces UNKNOWN; exclusions have recorded applicability reasons.
requirements.deliverable: Assessment instrument and complete coverage matrix
requirements.test: Run a complete synthetic case and a sparse case; verify all work items are accounted for and missing evidence remains UNKNOWN.
requirements.evidence: 180 item coverage and sparse evidence test record

requirements.title: Independent verification and finding lock
requirements.requirement: Validate citations and independently challenge candidate claims before they become decision-eligible locked findings. Preserve contradictions, unresolved claims and evidence ceilings.
requirements.acceptance: Broken citations and unsupported claims cannot lock. Code evidence cannot establish TESTED status, and test evidence cannot establish OPERATIONALLY_OBSERVED status.
requirements.deliverable: Claim verifier, adjudication route and finding ledger
requirements.test: Inject fabricated locators, unsupported claims and excessive assurance states; confirm rejection or unresolved status.
requirements.evidence: Citation, independence and evidence ceiling test record

requirements.title: Deterministic readiness and hard gates
requirements.requirement: Calculate applicability, readiness dimensions and hard gates from governed rules and locked evidence. Aggregate scores and narrative must not override blockers or accept residual risk.
requirements.acceptance: A case with a high diagnostic score and a mandatory blocker remains blocked. Residual risk remains NOT_DETERMINED without authorized evaluation.
requirements.deliverable: Readiness decision kernel and hard gate rules
requirements.test: Evaluate a high score case containing a blocker and an unevaluated risk; confirm both boundaries remain enforced.

requirements.title: Exact tactics and reassessment
requirements.requirement: Retrieve only approved tactics mapped to locked capability or anti-pattern IDs. Tactic completion creates new evidence and requires reassessment rather than closing findings automatically.
requirements.acceptance: Keyword similarity alone retrieves no tactic. Unresolved claims retrieve none; completing a mapped tactic does not automatically close its finding.
requirements.deliverable: Finding to tactic mapping and reassessment workflow
requirements.test: Compare exact ID, keyword-only and unresolved cases; complete a tactic and inspect the still-open finding before reverification.
requirements.evidence: Tactic eligibility and finding lifecycle test record

requirements.title: Controlled narrative and publication integrity
requirements.requirement: Explain locked results without altering scores or inventing actions. Independently check synthesis, quarantine unsupported prose and calculate publication status separately from readiness.
requirements.acceptance: Unsupported prose is withheld or replaced with deterministic wording. REPORT_READY does not change readiness or authorize deployment.
requirements.deliverable: Synthesis fact check and publication gate
requirements.test: Insert an unsupported narrative claim and compare publication status with unchanged deterministic readiness.
requirements.evidence: Narrative quarantine and publication separation test record

requirements.title: Canonical readiness package and trace
requirements.requirement: Publish one versioned ReadinessPackageV2 for the Assessment Workspace, Assurance Summary and exports. Bind intake, evidence, domains, findings, actions, gates and execution trace.
requirements.acceptance: Workspace and summary display the same package identity and results. Exporting does not recalculate readiness; every decisive finding links to its evidence and governing object.
requirements.deliverable: Canonical package, workspace, summary and exports
requirements.test: Render the same fixture in both views and an export; compare package identity, decisions and requirement to evidence links.
requirements.evidence: Package identity and view consistency test record

requirements.title: Information boundaries and human authority
requirements.requirement: Keep raw sources process-local and restrict future model calls to approved summaries and confirmed intake. Protect access, audit actions and reserve legal, risk and lifecycle decisions for named humans.
requirements.acceptance: Provider packet fixtures contain no raw files, pixels or secrets. Unauthorized access is denied, audit records omit credentials, and the Engine cannot grant formal approval.
requirements.deliverable: Packet boundary, access controls and authority ledger
requirements.test: Inspect packet fixtures and access denial cases; attempt an automated approval and confirm refusal.
requirements.evidence: Packet, access and authority boundary test record

tasks.title: Register the SAE build intent
tasks.detail: Bind CSCF-SAE-NB-001 v1.0 to the declared purpose, intended users and proposed delivery boundary.

tasks.title: Establish the evidence and target state
tasks.detail: Inventory the brief as declared source material. Separate proposed architecture from implemented or tested claims.

tasks.title: Map affected boundaries
tasks.detail: Trace local evidence intake, future model packets, assessment workspaces and named human decision rights.

tasks.title: Activate applicable control packs
tasks.detail: Select security, privacy, AI governance and evidence integrity requirements for the SAE target design.

tasks.title: Bind obligations to required proof
tasks.detail: Associate source boundaries and A-F controls with acceptance criteria; preserve unknown applicability for human resolution.

tasks.title: Establish the purpose baseline
tasks.detail: Record the scenario's purpose and users. The Engine supports readiness decisions; named humans retain approval authority.

tasks.title: Freeze ten acceptance requirements
tasks.detail: Check SAE-REQ-01 through SAE-REQ-10 for measurable proof conditions and record the prepared demo owner decision.

tasks.title: Prepare the implementation contract
tasks.detail: Bound deliverables to safe intake, governed knowledge, assessment, finding lock, readiness, actions and canonical outputs.

tasks.title: Derive independent verification
tasks.detail: Bind SAE-VER-01 through SAE-VER-10 to the original requirements, including negative and missing-evidence cases.

tasks.title: Check contract readiness
tasks.detail: Confirm complete requirement coverage, protected authority boundaries and the scoped demo work packet.

tasks.title: Authorize the bounded executor
tasks.detail: Simulate an approved implementation route. The executor receives no authority to clear gates, accept risk or deploy.

tasks.title: Prepare acquisition and intake deliverables
tasks.detail: Load prepared source manifests, confirmation snapshots and knowledge integrity fixtures for the demonstration.

tasks.title: Prepare the assessment and control candidate
tasks.detail: Load the scripted A-F coverage, claim verification, finding lock and deterministic readiness deliverables.

tasks.title: Capture candidate outputs
tasks.detail: Register prepared tactic mapping, publication and canonical package outputs as candidate deliverables awaiting verification.

tasks.title: Review structural and security checks
tasks.detail: Show prepared build, dependency, secrets and access-boundary check results. These are simulated scenario records.

tasks.title: Verify behavior and negative cases
tasks.detail: Review human confirmation, 180-item coverage and unsupported-claim rejection against SAE-VER-02, 04 and 05.

tasks.title: Challenge gate and tactic boundaries
tasks.detail: Review high-score blockers, exact-ID tactic eligibility and the requirement for reverification before finding closure.

tasks.title: Complete the requirement proof map
tasks.detail: Compare publication integrity, canonical outputs and human authority with the ten acceptance criteria.

tasks.title: Review assurance across A-F
tasks.detail: Expand from local controls to affected information boundaries and the whole SAE purpose and governance design.

tasks.title: Check acceptance and remediation status
tasks.detail: Record the scripted verification route as satisfied. Production effectiveness remains unobserved; formal approval stays pending.

tasks.title: Assemble the document of approval
tasks.detail: Match the prepared readiness package to CSCF-SAE-NB-001 v1.0. Hold the workflow for a human decision without deployment.
